title: Among patients diagnosed with SJS who were born before 1960, find those who
question: Among patients diagnosed with SJS who were born before 1960, find those who had a lab test in November and another in December of the same year, where the November total cholesterol (T-CHO) was more than 10% higher than the December value. Return their ID, sex, year, and percentage decrease.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  p."XCL_058" AS ID,
  p."XCL_059" AS sex,
  nov."XCL_015" AS year,
  (nov."XCL_026" - dec."XCL_026") * 100.0 / dec."XCL_026" AS percentage_decrease
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS nov
  ON p."XCL_058" = nov."XCL_014"
JOIN Laboratory AS dec
  ON p."XCL_058" = dec."XCL_014"
WHERE p."XCL_064" = 'SJS'
  AND p."XCL_060" < '1960-01-01'
  AND nov."XCL_015" LIKE '%-11-%'
  AND dec."XCL_015" LIKE '%-12-%'
  AND nov."XCL_015" LIKE dec."XCL_015" || '-%'
  AND nov."XCL_026" > 1.1 * dec."XCL_026"

  T1."XCL_058" AS ID,

  T2."XCL_042" AS year,

 AND T2."XCL_015" LIKE '%-11-%'
